voyage.name: RAW Gelände
voyage.content: The RAW Gelände is one of Berlin's best known and wildest culture and party areas. It is on the old railway repair premises of the former (East) German State Railway (Reichsbahn) and includes several clubs (Lokschuppen Berlin, Cassiopeia, Haubentaucher, Der weiße Hase), concert venues (e.g. Astra Kulturhaus), Bars (e.g. Badehaus), the outdoor climbing park Kegel at a former cone-shaped WWII high-rise bunker, the indo

voyage.name: Museum in der Kulturbrauerei
voyage.content: Find out how it felt to live in East Germany in this modern and well-presented exhibition. The museum is a good starting point if you only have a few minutes to sneak a quick peek inside an East German family's living room, but you can spend hours diving further into the stories behind each exhibit by flicking through the documents on display or listening to contemporary witnesses' accounts (English translations avai

voyage.name: Kollwitzplatz
voyage.content: The Kollwitzplatz, with a small nice park, is one of Berlin's most beautiful Gründerzeit city squares. Together with the Kollwitzstraße which is crossing it, it offers many cafés and restaurants, but is also a well-known symbol in Germany for gentrification since the late 1990s. Its flea market which takes place every Sunday in one of Berlin's best known and focuses on international delicatessen foods.

voyage.name: Kastanienallee
voyage.content: Kastanienallee is well known for its numerous cafés and fashion stores, as well as its many cultural venues in the backyards such as alternative cinemas, theaters and beergardens.

voyage.name: Oderberger Straße
voyage.content: Oderberger Straße is known for its beautiful and generous Gründerzeit architecture, as well as its cafés and restaurants. Since before Germany's reunification the street has been the desired place for alternative folks and avant-gardists, but the area has seen continual gentrification since the early 2000s.

voyage.name: Wasserturm
voyage.content: The first (and one of the biggest) water tower of Berlin (built 1877).

voyage.name: Synagoge Rykestraße
voyage.content: The synagogue in the backyard of an apartment house is one of the biggest in Germany.

voyage.name: Jüdischer Friedhof Schönhauser Allee
voyage.content: Jewish cemetery and lapidarium with old tombstones.

voyage.name: Gethsemanekirche
voyage.content: The meeting point of one of the leading oppositions against the GDR regime and is a great Neogothic church. Also the only ecumenical Lord's supper with Protestants and Catholics together took place in the Gethsemanekirche (2003).

voyage.name: Museum for Architectural Drawing
voyage.content: The museum is in an iconic building opened in June 2013, showcases privately owned collection of architectural drawings from the twentieth and twenty-first centuries..

voyage.name: Berlin from below
voyage.hours: Several daily tours 10:00-16:00 in different languages
voyage.content: Go on guided tours below Berlin to the World War II bunkers, flak towers, Cold War defence shelters, etc.

voyage.name: Humboldthain
voyage.content: A pleasant park, featuring an anti-aircraft gun emplacement ("Flakturm") which offers sweeping views over Berlin

voyage.name: SAVVY Contempo­rary
voyage.content: A space for art exhibitions, events and discussion in the silent green Kulturquartier, a former crematorium.

voyage.name: English Theatre Berlin
voyage.content: Theatre that features all plays/music theatre in English.

voyage.name: Kino Moviemento
voyage.content: Cinema showing independent and older movies, some in English. It is the oldest cinema in Germany (1907).

voyage.name: Babylon Kreuzberg
voyage.content: Also non-mainstream movies in this small cinema built in the 1950s.

voyage.name: Badeschiff
voyage.price: entrance 8 EUR, requires pre-booked time slot, charges for drinks
voyage.content: An old cargo ship hull converted to a fresh-water swimming pool, anchored permanently on the river Spree. Provides a nice opportunity to swim on the Spree, without actually swimming in the river itself, which is far too polluted. A bar with disco DJ music is situated just next to the pool. In winter time, the pool is covered against the weather.

voyage.name: East Side Gallery
voyage.content: The longest stretch of the Berlin Wall that is still standing. It has been painted by street artists and has several famous art pieces. (If you want to see the wall in its original condition, see the Gedenkstatte Berliner Mauer in Wedding.)

voyage.name: Der Kegel
voyage.price: Day ticket €7, rope climbing after 15:00 €5, kids €4
voyage.content: At this outdoor climbing area which is on the RAW Gelände you can do rope climbing at a cone-shaped high-rise bunker from World War II, called the Kegel (cone). The venue also offers an indoor and outdoor bouldering area. In the Kegel shop you can rent or buy climbing gear and book rope climbing or bouldering courses. In summer, there is also an open-air cinema and a beergarden right next to the Kegel.

voyage.name: Spielwiese
voyage.price: €1 per person, per hour; €3 to rent games overnight
voyage.content: Café with over 1200 high-quality board, card, and dice games, both European and American, available to play. Many have rules in English. Perfect for a rainy day. Food and drinks for sale.

voyage.name: Paint Your Style
voyage.content: Paint your own piece of ceramic and have it glazed and burned. Pick it up after 1-3 days.

voyage.name: Uber Arena
voyage.alt: known as "Mercedes Benz Arena" from 2015-2024, and "O2 world" before then
voyage.content: A modern indoor sports and concert venue, it is among other things the permanent home of Alba Berlin, Berlin's premier Basketball team and Eisbären Berlin, the professional Ice Hockey club of Berlin.

voyage.name: Mauerpark
voyage.content: At the end of the Eberswalder Straße, it was once a piece of the Berlin wall. Today in the summer it is a nice place to be, especially for young people. There's an interesting flea market going on every weekend. In the summer weekend afternoons, you can witness - or participate in - the Bearpit Karaoke.

voyage.name: Bearpit Karaoke
voyage.content: Open-air karaoke at the amphitheater in Mauerpark where the bravest can show off to the incidental audience.

voyage.name: KulturBrauerei
voyage.content: A complex that was once a brewery. There you can find the Jazz Cafe, the SODA restaurant where you can enjoy a fine meal of insects, and some clubs: Club 23, nbi and frannz. The KulturBrauerei also has several cinemas showing alternative movies, the Kesselhaus concert house, and one of the best shops for instruments in Berlin, the "Sound and Drumland".

voyage.name: Kastanienallee and Oderberger Straße
voyage.content: Nice streets with lots of little shops and cafes to sit outside in the summer and watch people pass by.

voyage.name: Helmholtzplatz
voyage.content: Little park with cafes and restaurants surrounding it.

voyage.name: Kopfgeldjäger
voyage.content: Get your hair cut for €20.

voyage.name: Max Schmeling Halle
voyage.content: Named after the 1930s boxing great and home of the Berlin Füchse (originally from Reinickendorf) the premier Handball team of Berlin

voyage.name: Friedrich Ludwig Jahn Sportpark
voyage.content: A soccer and American Football stadium with track and field facilities which has been host to several important competitions in the past, including German Bowls (finals of the German American Football League) from 2012 to 2018.

voyage.name: Freibad Plötzensee
voyage.hours: May-Sep (opening period varies according to the weather): daily from 09:00
voyage.content: A public beach at the small natural lake Plötzensee.

voyage.name: Karstadt Hermannplatz
voyage.content: Built in 1929; large shopping center including clothing, book, and beauty products shops, a post office, and its own high-end supermarket, (probably only second to KaDeWe in the area). The grocery section of Karstadt has fresh meat, seafood, and cheese sections.

voyage.name: Marheineke Markthalle
voyage.content: A market hall with different vendors (mostly food and drinks) including butchers, bakeries, delicatessen, fruits and vegetables etc.

voyage.name: Markthalle Neun
voyage.content: A market hall.

voyage.name: Historischer Weichnatsmarkt Friedrichshain
voyage.content: An atmospheric Christmas market with a charming medieval theme.

voyage.name: Hardwax
voyage.content: The techno record shop in Berlin; huge back catalogue and weekly news from around the world; also reggae 7" and drum&bass.

voyage.name: Heisse Scheiben
voyage.content: Big second-hand record store.

voyage.name: SpaceHall
voyage.content: A large selection of electronic music, from the latest releases to older vinyl.

voyage.name: Flaming Squeegee
voyage.content: Funny, creative selection of rockabilly and punk t-shirts, bar, and band merchandise.

voyage.name: Nüx Siebdruckwaren
voyage.content: Friedrichshain is full of screenprinted t-shirt stores, but Nüx stands out with their high-quality natural-history-museum designs such as owls, fish, and foxes.

voyage.name: boxoffberlin
voyage.content: Only 100 m from Checkpoint Charlie you will find a small but very interesting place for extraordinary souvenirs and gifts made by local designers. The gallery shows changing exhibitions of contemporary art, films and more from Berlin artists and the little Café offers the best Espresso – fairly traded and organically grown, refreshing lemonades without artificial additives, »Berliner Weisse with a shot« ... in summer

voyage.name: Modulor
voyage.content: Berlin's biggest and best art, craft, and design supply store. A must-visit if you are at all artistically inclined.

voyage.name: Aufschnitt
voyage.content: Berlin's only 'textile butchery' sells pillows shaped like meat, made 'fresh' on the premises by Silvia – a unique and whimsical Berlin souvenir.

voyage.name: Schwesterherz / Küchenliebe
voyage.content: Two 'sister' stores next to each other – one is a well-curated papeterie, the other focuses on kitchenwares.

voyage.name: Mauerpark Flea Market
voyage.content: Great Sunday flea market for vintage clothing, furniture, rare vinyl; not many professionals. A typical Berlin experience.

voyage.name: Dense
voyage.content: Electronic music.

voyage.name: Der Plattenladen
voyage.content: Techno

voyage.name: Da Capo
voyage.content: Second-hand, rock, pop.

voyage.name: Hip-Hop-Records
voyage.content: Hip hop.

voyage.name: OYE Records
voyage.content: When this record store opened in 2002, it mainly specialized in Latin, Brazil and Italo house, disco and nu-jazz tunes. Today it offers vinyl from a wider range of genres including techno, electro and house.

voyage.name: Dodo Beach East
voyage.content: Punk, rock, reggae.

voyage.name: Mundo Azul
voyage.content: International children's and youth literature and music.

voyage.name: Jokers Restseller
voyage.content: For a wide variety of cheap secondhand books.

voyage.name: Tausche
voyage.content: Berlin fans from all over the world can be spotted with the television tower, the city map or Berlin’s area code +49 30 on their tausche bags with exchangeable flaps and insets.

voyage.name: Princigalli
voyage.content: Quality shoes and cosmetics for ladies.

voyage.name: Who Killed Bambi?
voyage.content: Colourful tops, bags & things.

voyage.name: Sgt. Peppers
voyage.content: 70s secondhand.

voyage.name: Pauls Boutique
voyage.content: Sneakers.

voyage.name: Eisdieler
voyage.content: Sneakers.

voyage.name: Hit-in.tv
voyage.content: Clothing store.

voyage.name: La Lampisterie
voyage.content: Great selection of old design lamps in a crazy shop.

voyage.name: Farmers Market
voyage.content: A small open-air farmers market right on Leopoldplatz.

voyage.name: Curry 36
voyage.content: Excellent pork sausage (German: Wurst) with curry ketchup and curry powder.

voyage.name: Hannibal
voyage.content: Serves burgers and weekend buffet breakfast, good cocktails in the evening.

voyage.name: Morgenland
voyage.content: Asian breakfast buffet on weekends (reservation essential!), restaurant and bar every day with good food for mid-range prices.

voyage.name: Mustafas Gemüse Kebap
voyage.price: Chicken döner with vegetable: €2.90, vegetable kebap: €3.50
voyage.content: Regarded as the best Döner Kebab in Berlin. Mustafas is a local institution and draws crowds of tourists and Berliners day and night. Expect to stand in line for 20-40 minutes to get your kebab, which attests to the reputation that this place has. Drink beer from the convenience store while you wait.

voyage.name: Nil
voyage.content: Sudanese fast food shop, serves excellent falafel and other Arabic snacks together with peanut sauce.

voyage.name: Sarod's Thai Restaurant
voyage.content: This authentic Thai restaurant offers great food made from fresh ingredients. The ambiente and staff are nice and friendly, and they know English (and Thai, for that matter). Most meals are available as a small portion.

voyage.name: Tiki Heart
voyage.content: Innovative and creative Asian, Polynesian and South American breakfast.

voyage.name: To Loc
voyage.content: Indochinese cuisine. Some consider it the best Asian kitchen in the neighborhood.

voyage.name: Hamy Cafe
voyage.content: Delicious Vietnamese cuisine, a main course for €4.90. They have a daily changing menu and great lassis.

voyage.name: Kantina von Hugo
voyage.content: Small cozy Mediterranean mama-style home cooking situated near the Landwehrkanal. The menu is small but changes everyday. Friendly and not too expensive, very nice wines. Fresh pasta is a must.

voyage.name: Angus Restaurant Steak-Haus
voyage.content: Pizza, pasta, different steaks etc. It's one of the cheapest restaurants in Kreuzberg and because of this very crowded (which is part of the nice atmosphere).

voyage.name: Asador Steakhouse
voyage.content: Spanish and Argentinian food. Food is good and portions are not so small, waiters are able to speak English. Have a look at the water and drink prices and the taxes to avoid surprises.

voyage.name: Café Sarotti-Höfe
voyage.content: In a former chocolate factory. Buffet for €12, brunch on Sunday for €14.90.

voyage.name: Hasir
voyage.price: Main courses still a steal at €6-11
voyage.content: The flagship of a chain run by Mehmet Aygun, who has a pretty good claim to inventing the döner kebab as we know it.

voyage.name: Kuchenkaiser
voyage.content: Institution for generation 68, breakfast till 16:00 and global kitchen highlights every week.

voyage.name: RosaCaleta
voyage.content: Jamaican-European fusion food.

voyage.name: Restaurant Tim Raue
voyage.content: Michelin-restaurant serving Asian fusion dishes.

voyage.name: Burgeramt
voyage.price: €7.50 for a basic burger, €4.50 for fries.
voyage.content: Huge selection of gourmet burgers at reasonable prices. Mediterranean, gorgonzola/walnut, vegetarian, etc., with plenty of homemade relishes and dressings. There is a take-away shop in no 22 and a restaurant in no 21, but the benches outside the take-away shop are crowded, especially in summer.

voyage.name: Nil Sudanesische Spezialitäten
voyage.content: Unique place with ethnic cuisine from Sudan. Wonderful place for anybody who would like to taste something from Africa, like quark cheese with fenugreek and black cumin or peanut soup - different and original.

voyage.name: Lagom
voyage.content: Restaurant and cocktail bar. Free wireless Internet

voyage.name: Fischschuppen
voyage.content: Very fresh and good fish. Select your fish and have the chef cook it.

voyage.name: Freischwimmer
voyage.content: Beautiful waterside restaurant on a wooden quay with European dishes and a relaxing view on the Flutgraben river branch.

voyage.name: Lisboa Bar am Boxi
voyage.content: Portuguese tapas, bread, wine, beer and coffee. Good place to have a real dinner or just hang our and share a bottle of wine with a couple of tapas

voyage.name: Mutzenbacher
voyage.content: Austrian restaurant. The best schnitzels in the area. The vegetables are great too.

voyage.name: Schneeweiss
voyage.content: Very white and clean but still cozy restaurant with knodels, schnitzel and other German food. Very popular, so make a reservation. Has a great Sunday brunch with a buffet of dishes in individual glass jars.

voyage.name: Schoenbrunn Restaurant
voyage.content: The Schoenbrunn Restaurant is in the Volkspark Friedrichshain next to "Großer Teich". There's also a beergarden where you can sit outside in the sun.

voyage.name: Turnhalle
voyage.content: This big old gym is turned into a spacious restaurant, lounge and cocktail bar. Free wireless internet.

voyage.name: Bangkok Treffpunkt
voyage.content: Thai restaurant. Excellent service. Recommended for value and food quality by many in the tourist scene. Has same prices as in 1996.

voyage.name: Butter
voyage.content: Good food, nice salads, reasonable prices.

voyage.name: Kleine Eiszeit
voyage.content: The best ice-cream in Prenzlauer Berg, expect a long queue, closed in winter.

voyage.name: Konnopke's Imbiß
voyage.content: Known for their Currywurst and their good curry sausage. A local would ask for a "Curry mit 'ner Schrippe" (a Currywurst with a roll). Since 1930.

voyage.name: Neugrüns Köche
voyage.content: Modern German kitchen with daily changing menus. Opens at 18:00.

voyage.name: Pizzeria I Due Forni
voyage.content: Water (Tafelwasser) is free, a rarity in Germany.

voyage.name: Prater
voyage.content: A beer garden with a restaurant under shady chestnut trees. The oldest beer garden in Berlin.

voyage.name: FrischeParadies Bistro
voyage.content: Small bistro inside upscale supermarket. Sit at the small tables or at the bar, where you can watch the chef prepare your meal from scratch with fresh high quality ingredients. The food is simple and fresh, always excellent cuts of meat or fish. The wine by the glass is a good deal, which you know because you can pick up a bottle from the wine-rack behind you when you leave.

voyage.name: Agni
voyage.content: Excellent Indian food.

voyage.name: Knodelwirtschaft NORD
voyage.content: Traditional German dumpling place. Food and service is great

voyage.name: St. Bess
voyage.content: A restaurant making very good pizza with vegetarian or vegan toppings. Their wood-fired oven is right at the entrance of the place, and you sit downstairs in the basement (or outside in summer).

voyage.name: Gaststätte Deichgraf
voyage.price: Mains €7-14 (you'll find enough options at both ends)
voyage.content: Good German food. Has a nice outside seating area in summer covered by trees.

voyage.name: Bar 11
voyage.content: Bar in the heart of Kreuzberg, DJs on the weekend (rock, pop, funk, soul, disco), entrance is free and international audience. Mondays all cocktails half price.

voyage.name: Bar Sofia
voyage.content: Small café and bar with a bit tacky but very nice interior. Open daily from 09:00. Hot drinks till 20:00, alcoholic drinks from 18:00. Outside sitting permitted only until 00:00.

voyage.name: Café Wendel
voyage.content: Cozy retro-style bar with a lot of vintage furnishings, graffiti and typographic artworks on the wall, a large selection of beverages including bio drinks and regularly live music.

voyage.name: Crack Bellmer
voyage.content: Popular bar-club, offering live music, funk, disco and house music in an old brick building on the RAW compound.

voyage.name: Die Legende von Paula und Ben
voyage.content: Small and cosy bar with a large choice of cocktails, spirits and wine. For those who are hungry this place serves tapas and for those who want to smoke some cigars.

voyage.name: Galander Haifischbar
voyage.content: Bar with sushi and excellent cocktail and whiskey selection.

voyage.name: Holzmarkt 25
voyage.content: Sort of a cultural village at the Spree River founded by an alternative cooperative with a restaurant, bar, club, beer garden, an acrobat's hall, music studios and a bakery.

voyage.name: Hops and Barley Hausbrauerei
voyage.content: Microbrewery in former butcher shop. They have a good selections on tap, all own production and from other microbreweries.

voyage.name: Madame CLAUDE
voyage.content: Gigs 5 days a week (indie-rock, experimental, folk). Crazy decor (everything is upside-down). Open daily from 18:00 till late.

voyage.name: Orient Lounge
voyage.content: Relaxing lounge with good drinks.

voyage.name: Wild at Heart
voyage.content: Punkrock Club with live music, great deco.

voyage.name: Wirtschaftswunder
voyage.content: Synonymous with the expression "economic miracle". The prices are very low and it has a good local Kreuzberg atmosphere.

voyage.name: Wuergeengel
voyage.content: Great bar for cocktails. Fills up fast even on weekdays and is very crowded on Fridays and Saturdays.

voyage.name: Zyankali Bar
voyage.content: The most adventurous bar in Berlin. You'll be surprised what kind of drinks they have on their beverage list. They say some people entered the Zyankali and never came out again.

voyage.name: Noble Rot
voyage.hours: Tue-Sat from 17:00, Sun from 14:00, closed Mon
voyage.content: Cozy wine bar with a selection of interesting German wines. And some Hungarian. They also serve delicious sausages and cheeses.

voyage.name: About Blank
voyage.content: This techno club founded by a leftist collective is in a rundown industrial area. The club is known for its endless niches and corners and has two floors and a garden. Guests should know which DJs are playing this night.

voyage.name: Astra Kulturhaus
voyage.content: Popular nightclub and concert venue on the RAW compound with beergarden and international bookings.

voyage.name: Badehaus
voyage.content: Nightclub on the RAW compound, offering indie and jazz concerts, hip hop jams and house music in an old industrial building.

voyage.name: Berghain/Panorama Bar
voyage.content: Techno club in an old cogeneration plant near the Ostbahnhof. It has a huge dancefloor and room for more than 1500 people. Panorama Bar upstairs is open late until Sunday afternoon. Gay friendly, with hidden darkrooms and leatherboys. Be prepared for tough door policy on popular nights. Not for teenagers, no cameras allowed (mobile phones with a camera are allowed, but holders are expressly warned not to use them).

voyage.name: Cassiopeia
voyage.content: Eclectic mix of shows on, most nights of the week. good hip hop, reggae, drum’n’bass and electro events across 3 rooms and a terrace in an old factory. €5-10 entry. Opens about 10 but typically quiet until 00:00-01:00. Good strip of small vegetarian cafes in the same alley if you need to kill some time. Beers €2.50.

voyage.name: Club der Visionäre
voyage.content: Atmospheric club at the waterside well-known for minimal techno, house and techno-house and high-grade DJ bookings. Originally only a summer venue, it now also has an indoor winter location at the MS Hoppetosse excursion ship which is docked nearby.

voyage.name: Gretchen
voyage.content: Drum ’n’ Bass, Latin, hip-hop and Afrobeat club within a vaulted former military horse stable.

voyage.name: Hoppetosse
voyage.content: This is a club for minimal techno and house located on a permanently docked excursion ship on the Spree river, the MS Hoppetosse. It is the winter venue for the Club der Visionäre. It has one dance floor and a Martion Bullfrog sound system.

voyage.name: IPSE
voyage.content: This techno club began as a cozy, wild and wooden open-air club at the waterside for the summer season, but now also offers two indoor dancefloors. It is behind the Freischwimme restaurant. The warehouse-like mainfloor has a decent Kirsch audio system.

voyage.name: K17
voyage.content: 4 floors of goth, industrial, synthpop, post-punk, wave, metal, hardcore and punk, in a backstreet of Friedrichshain. Impressive exterior and outdoor bar. Less snobby than some goth clubs, but the unofficial dress code is all black.

voyage.name: Kater Blau
voyage.content: Techno club at the Spree river with an open-air area. DJs from the in-house label Katermukke play here regularly.

voyage.name: Lokschuppen Berlin
voyage.content: Techno club with an indoor dancefloor in a former railway depot, an outdoor dancefloor and a garden. It is 100 meters away from the Warschauer Straße S-Bahn station on the former RAW railway compound. Techno, electro and house bookings.

voyage.name: L.U.X.
voyage.content: This club in a decommissioned industrial building pours on the charm with its old pipes and control panels. DJ are playing electro, funk, nu disco or salsa in this often artfully decorated venue. Inexpensive drinks and bio beer available.

voyage.name: Matrix
voyage.content: This long-standing dance music club is located within ten claybrick vaults beneath the Warschauer Straße U-Bahn station. Once purely electronic, it nowadays offers a wide range of dance music genres. With its sociable atmosphere it attracts a predominantly younger party crowd which is not fixed on a certain genre.

voyage.name: OST
voyage.content: This techno club in a former harbor generating plant is the successor of the noted Magdalena club and has a huge dance floor and an audio system designed by Gary Stewart.

voyage.name: Prince Charles
voyage.content: This is a house and hip-hop club in the facilities of a former indoor swimming pool. It is decorated with light bulbs hanging from the ceiling, a wooden DJ booth and dancefloor and the bar is in the dry swimming pool. It is known for high-grade house bookings and has a Funktion One sound system.

voyage.name: Ritter Butzke
voyage.content: This techno club on three levels with an old commercial building is known for its artful decoration. It has a dance floor called Dampfmaschine.

voyage.name: SO36
voyage.content: Nightclub whose roots are punk, nowadays plays different alternative and mainstream concerts. Don't miss the Gayhane, the Turkish "homoriental" gay party.

voyage.name: Wilde Renate
voyage.content: This techno club behind a wooden fence and with its numerous artfully decorated rooms is one of the most renowned in Berlin.

voyage.name: YAAM
voyage.content: Large reggae/dancehall, hip-hop and afrobeat club in the factory building which previously housed the clubs Maria am Ostbahnhof and Deli an der Schillingbrücke. A focus on street art and street sports and a beach bar in summer.

voyage.name: Al Hamra
voyage.content: Relaxed Mediterranean/Arabic style bar cafe serving good food, with occasional music and movies, has a separate smoking section.

voyage.name: An einem Sonntag im August
voyage.content: Iconic café-bar in a retro living room style right at the entrance of Kastanienalle from where locals overlook the neighborhood from behind large windows. With regular live DJs, readings and Hollywood swings on the street.

voyage.name: August Fengler
voyage.content: Longstanding and often crowded bar with kickers and small dance floor. DJs play indie, latin, disco or electro.

voyage.name: Café Hilde
voyage.content: A large bright corner cafe and bar. Direct fair trade coffee, organic teas & ice cream, home-made cakes. Evenings there is bistro food including pastas and salads.

voyage.name: Kakao
voyage.content: Popular cafe and bar specializing in chocolate, ran by the chocolate shop next door. Has a great view of Helmholtzplatz and good hot chocolate.

voyage.name: Kauf Dich Glücklich Café
voyage.content: This iconic café with its diversified collection of colored retro chairs and its wild, overgrown outdoor terrace which is so typical of the hipster-hedonist Kastanienallee-Oderbergerstraße heighborhood offers crêpes, waffles, housemade ice cream, and an excellent breakfast. On crowded weekends, count in some waiting time.

voyage.name: Kulturbrauerei
voyage.content: A former brewery which now houses many bars and restaurant. The Soda Club has an excellent bar.

voyage.name: Morgenrot
voyage.content: Alternative cafe serving vegetarian and vegan food, quite a recommended place for people interested in squats and related issues.

voyage.name: No Fire No Glory
voyage.content: Third wave coffee place with a beautiful terrace and homemade sweets & savory food. Its espresso blends include 'the coffee collective' Copenhagen and 'bonanza coffee heroes' Berlin. Pour-over coffee with single origins for a real caffeine high are obtained too.

voyage.name: Pfefferberg
voyage.content: This is a large former brewery compound which has been reused as a cultural and nightlife center with changing clubs, bars, theaters, restaurants, a large beer garden, a hostel and artist's studios for decades. It is a bit similar to the Kulturbrauerei but has been wilder and more run-down until its renovation.

voyage.name: Schwarz-Sauer
voyage.content: Very popular bar with a local and international student crowd.

voyage.name: Wohnzimmer
voyage.content: The first 'trendy' bar in this part of Prenzlberg and still very popular. Serves breakfasts and is open late. Separate smoking room

voyage.name: Zu Mir Oder Zu Dir
voyage.content: Retro-stlye bar with very relaxed atmosphere, genuine 1970s interior and excellent drinks. The prices are fair and the bartenders are nice. DJs play electro or soul.

voyage.name: Dunckerclub
voyage.content: Alternative, hard rock, indie.

voyage.name: frannz
voyage.content: A relaxed pop/rock club in Kulturbrauerei, also with live music.

voyage.name: Brauerei Eschenbräu
voyage.content: A small brewery. In summer, they also have a biergarden (one of the few in Berlin where you can actually bring your own food). Throughout the year you can drink their beer in the bar (no outside food allowed there). They also distill spirits (including whisky).

voyage.name: Vagabund Brauerei
voyage.content: A micro-brewery. You can drink their beer from tap (and other bottled beers) at their nice bar. Has some outside seating in summer. You can bring or order your own food and consume it in the bar.

voyage.name: BackpackerBerlin
voyage.content: Cosy hostel providing room types such as dorms and private accommodations. Bathrooms and rooms are very clean and you´ll be equipped with Wi-Fi, internet, free coffee/tea, washing machine, computers, common kitchen.

voyage.name: Hotel ibis Berlin Ostbahnhof
voyage.price: Double room €60 if booked in advance

voyage.name: All In Hostel Berlin
voyage.content: Silent back yard, built in 1911, factory loft.

voyage.name: A&O
voyage.price: Double rooms start at €24 per person, dorm starts at €10

voyage.name: Pegasus Hostel Berlin
voyage.content: 2-bed rooms start at €19 per person, dorm starts at €14. One of this independent hostel's main attractions is its large, green courtyard which hosts a beer garden, BBQ, table tennis and comfortable seating areas. They have free internet access, laundry service and multilingual staff. They offer accommodations from single rooms with showers and WC, to beds in dormitory rooms.

voyage.name: U Inn Berlin Hostel
voyage.content: Another cosy backpacker hostel that offers singles, doubles and dorms.

voyage.name: Sunflower Hostel
voyage.content: Dorms from €10/person, they also have doubles and apartments. The sunny side of Berlin, nicely decorated rooms.

voyage.name: Eastern & Western Comfort Hotelboat
voyage.content: Dorms from €16/person, they also have singles and doubles.

voyage.name: Baxpax Kreuzberg Hostel Berlin
voyage.content: Kreuzberg's first hostel (est. 2000) is just off the main drag. Facilities are well maintained with very clean bathrooms/showers. Young (twenties) and mixed crowd. Beer for sale at all hours!

voyage.name: Three Little Pigs Hostel
voyage.content: The hostel is in an old nunnery in Kreuzberg next to S Anhalter Bhf.

voyage.name: Grand Hostel Berlin
voyage.price: Rooms start at €17 (mixed 4-bed room) and go up to €40 for a private one-bed room
voyage.content: In one of Kreuzberg's "Kiez" a 15-min walk away from checkpoint Charlie. It's a renovated 19th-century building and all the interior is new. The service at the reception is also very nice and helpful.

voyage.name: Comebackpackers
voyage.content: They have a big common room, a full equipped kitchen and free Internet.

voyage.name: Die Fabrik
voyage.price: 2-bed rooms start at €49/room, dorm starts at €18
voyage.content: An old factory building turned into a hostel.

voyage.name: Riverside Lodge
voyage.content: Little hostel in the neighborhood of Kreuzberg.

voyage.name: City-Hotel Gotland
voyage.content: Bed and Breakfast. Staff speaks English.

voyage.name: Sarotti Höfe
voyage.content: 3-star hotel in a transformed chocolate company. Modernised rooms with good location to Bergmann Kietz. Known for its breakfast/brunch and good service. Popular with mid-aged city tourists in a small and cozy hotel.

voyage.name: Mövenpick Hotel Berlin
voyage.content: Uniquely designed hotel in Berlin's city centre, near Potsdamer Platz in the former Siemens building on Schöneberger Straße.

voyage.name: Alcatraz Backpacker Hostel
voyage.price: Double rooms start at €22 per person, dormitory starts at €13

voyage.name: Corner Hostel
voyage.price: 2-bed rooms start at €20 per person, dorm starts at €14

voyage.name: EastSeven Berlin Hostel
voyage.price: Dorm rooms starting at €13 in low season, €17 in high season
voyage.content: Private rooms also available.

voyage.name: Pension Absolut Berlin
voyage.content: Quiet location near Alexanderplatz. The guesthouse offers single, double, triple and fully served apartments.

voyage.name: Generator Hostel Berlin
voyage.price: 2-bed rooms start at €20 per person, dorm starts at €10

voyage.name: Lette'm Sleep
voyage.price: 2-bed rooms start at €24 per person, dorm starts at €15

voyage.name: Meininger Hotel Berlin Prenzlauer Berg
voyage.price: Double rooms start at €35 per person, dormitory starts at €19

voyage.name: Transit Loft
voyage.price: 2-bed rooms start at €71.50/room, dorm starts at €15 per person
voyage.content: Transit, Hagelberger Str. 53-54 (Kreuzberg) is also part of this hostel chain.

voyage.name: Pfefferbett
voyage.content: Central location, walking distance to Alexanderplatz and yet in another world. It's in an old brewery complex converted into a cultural center. Dorms, private rooms. Easy access also from Schönhauser Allee 176

voyage.name: Homestay accommodation
voyage.content: Reservations necessary, minimum stay two nights.

voyage.name: Hotel ackselhaus & blue home Berlin
voyage.content: In the centre of Berlin, 700 m away from the TV Tower, Alexanderplatz.

voyage.name: Red Rooster Bar and Hostel Odyssee
voyage.content: The Odyssee is independently run by a young crew - a real rock 'n 'roll place with a nice bar. This is a simple hostel which provides internet access, bicycle rental, and a bar (open until dawn).

voyage.name: Bed and Breakfast Ring
voyage.content: Bed and Breakfast. The staff speak English.

voyage.name: Frauenzimmer
voyage.content: Private accommodation for women, from women. Guestrooms and apartments.
